name: Wide Design Portfolio
tagline: Oversized Syne typography, black-and-white pages, fine rules, coral and yellow circular badges, and tightly cropped product photography.

palette.description: Pure black and white alternate with vivid coral and yellow circular badges.

typography.style: Embedded Syne 400, 600, and 700 for oversized uppercase display headings and body copy; embedded Space Grotesk 400, 500, and 700 for letter-spaced chrome and circular badges. Source letter spacing, line heights, and text frames are retained.

best_for: Designer and agency portfolios with strong project imagery, concise case-study narrative, credentials, and bold typographic section dividers.
avoid_for: Dense operational reports, chart-heavy financial reviews, long paragraphs, or formal presentations requiring restrained headings.

source_inspiration.name: Design Portfolio by Hrvoje Grubišić on Pitch
source_inspiration.notes: All 23 publicly rendered pages were inspected. Rebuilt with native editable HTML text, vector rules and circles, observed element coordinates, exact Syne/Space Grotesk families, and embedded original non-person still-life photography with source crop transforms. This is an HTML reconstruction, not an editable Pitch export. No human portraits occur in this source.
